post.summary:
Thinking about a new garage door for your Miami home? If the garage is attached, a door that bakes in the afternoon sun can send heat into the rooms next to it, and an insulated door is one way to take the edge off. It is mainly a comfort, noise and durability upgrade, so it makes the most sense for attached garages, west or south facing doors, and garages used as a workshop, gym or home office.

When you compare estimates, ask how the door is constructed, how it seals along the bottom and sides, how the finish handles humidity and salt air, and whether the springs and opener are matched to the heavier door. Our garage door installation team can walk you through the options and give you a free quote. The new guide lays out the full checklist.
